title: PH envoy presents credentials to North Korean leader Kim Jong Un
summary: The Philippine ambassador to North Korea presented his credentials to leader Kim Jong Un, marking the first time in more than 30 years that the country's leader personally received the credentials of…

blocks.text: The Philippine ambassador to North Korea presented his credentials to leader Kim Jong Un, marking the first time in more than 30 years that the country's leader personally received the credentials of foreign ambassadors, the Philippine Embassy in Beijing said Tuesday.
Ambassador Jaime FlorCruz presented his Letters of Credence in Pyongyang on November 22, alongside nine other ambassadors. He will be based in Beijing during his tenure.

“The Philippines stands ready to build partnerships with other countries, more so with its Asian neighbors, in order to create conditions that will allow all nations to enjoy peace and prosperity,” FlorCruz said in a statement.
In a brief speech during the ceremony, Kim expressed hope that the ambassadors would fulfill their missions and help build confidence between their respective countries.

FlorCruz also met with North Korean Vice Foreign Minister Pak Sang Gil and Director-General of the Department of Southeast Asian Affairs Kang Sung Ryong to discuss ways to develop bilateral relations.
The Philippines and North Korea established formal diplomatic relations in 2000. —VBL, GMA News
